summary: SaverOne 2014 Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq, furnished a Form 6-K reporting that its Annual General Meeting held September 29, 2026 approved each of the nine proposals presented, per the Notice and Proxy Statement dated August 17, 2026. The filing contains no transaction terms, no price per share, no stake, no advisor and no board recommendation beyond the ordinary meeting results, and the press release is incorporated by reference into the company's Form S-8 and Form F-3 registration statements. This is a routine meeting-result disclosure, not a special situation; no deal or risk-arb angle applies.
